question: Find the HCF of 2³ x 3³ x 5² x 7², 2⁴ x 3² x 5³ x 7² and 3 x 5 x 7 x 11
solution:
**Given:**

Find the HCF of:

 
• 2³ × 3³ × 5² × 7²
 
• 2⁴ × 3² × 5³ × 7²
 
• 3 × 5 × 7 × 11

**Formula Used:**

HCF = Product of the lowest powers of common prime factors.
